plugin.note: Wiki centres Karil on Magic (50% air weakness) with the shared setup; a melee/Piety kill is a supported alternative.

requirements: Access to Karil the Tainted's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.
mechanics: Wiki centres Karil on Magic (50% air weakness) with the shared setup; a melee/Piety kill is a supported alternative.
Treat this as a boss-specific method: positioning, prayer swaps, phase handling, and death-risk setup should come from the linked source strategy.
Use listed secondary weapons only where their combat style or phase role is relevant.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Wiki centres Karil on Magic (50% air weakness) with the shared setup; a melee/Piety kill is a supported alternative.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Wiki centres Karil on Magic (50% air weakness) with the shared setup; a melee/Piety kill is a supported alternative.

methods.label: Barrows route
methods.summary: Reach Barrows, check Karil's southern mound early enough to spend prayer, and bring restore support for his Agility drain if needed.
recommendedFor: Boss Slayer assignments that roll Karil
steps: Use a Barrows teleport or Mort'ton route to reach the mounds.
Prioritise Karil before lower-risk melee brothers if prayer is still available.
Use Protect from Missiles to block his ranged attacks.
Carry restore if his Agility drain affects route movement.
notes: The Wiki safe rotations place Karil before or near Ahrim and Verac.
Ghommal's hilt 2 or higher removes the Barrows Prayer drain.

methods.label: Protection prayer kill
methods.summary: Use Protect from Missiles, then kill Karil with air magic or a melee/Piety switch.
recommendedFor: players using the shared Barrows magic setup
steps: Turn on Protect from Missiles before fighting Karil.
Use air magic or a powered staff as the default shared setup.
Use melee with Piety as a supported alternative.
Restore drained Agility if it slows tunnel navigation.
risks: Karil has high accuracy and can drain Agility.
Prayer drain can make late Karil kills more supply-intensive.
notes: All brothers have a 50% air elemental weakness.
Melee/Piety is a documented alternative for Karil.

methods.label: Tunnel safespot
methods.summary: If Karil appears in the tunnels, use Protect from Missiles and kill him directly; tunnel safespots are mainly for melee brothers.
recommendedFor: Barrows runs with enough prayer remaining
steps: Turn on Protect from Missiles when Karil spawns.
Use magic or melee to kill him before opening the chest.
Use room geometry for spacing, but do not rely on melee-only safespot patterns.
notes: Karil attacks at range, so blocking melee pathing is not enough.
Prayer management is the key safety tool.
